title: 0277: the gate closure audit - five non-mechanism routes audited and closed (published laws 5.00x; class/envelope families 3.2-4.9x; continuous R-vM S-tail ~1e13 (10^12x); data wave to tPT2 infeasible on 329GB (S-diff sup over (t+1,16t] unfixable by data to 3e12: the gate's c2 piece is the TAIL; spacing-only cancellation = worst-phase sup = count*|term| (structural)). The window CENSUS datum landed meanwhile: k_L = 8 on-line zeros in (tPT2-1, tPT2+1] (measured in-house, 3-way verified); the measured pointwise S-oscillation residual ~1e-3 (vs the gate 2.5821) - the point PASSES, the sup-level gate REMAINS the input. The only remaining route is a genuinely new mechanism (0278): pair-correlation-strength unit-scale S-phase bounds for the unknown zeros. No RH claim; face OPEN.
why_this_unit: 0276 named the gate (the exact conditional input). Before investing in a mechanism, 0277 audits honestly that NO non-mechanism route closes it - so 0278 (the mechanism) is provably the next live unit, not a fallback.

audit.route4_dataWave: CLOSED AS A GATE ROUTE (feasibility audit, new): the fleet (a) wave (zero ordinates (3e10, 3.0002e12], 1.16e13 zeros) needs 92.8GB of f64 storage; the Strix node has 329GB free disk but the wave's PURPOSE (the gate c1/c2 pieces) is unreachable by it: (i) the c2 piece of the gate is the S-fluctuation over (t+1, 16t] = (3.000175e12, 4.8e13] - FAR BEYOND the wave (13x the height, 5.2e14 zeros, ~226x the wave cost (100-150 days -> ~25,000 fleet-days) even on the GPU RS engine (~10x, 25 days for the wave alone) - infeasible; (ii) even the c1 piece (gData, t-1] (which the wave covers) is bounded by the TRIANGLE |tail_t - tail_g| + |sum_t - sum_g|: the wave data fixes the sum part but the unknown zero TAIL over (g, 16g] (g up to 3e12: 1.9e14 zeros (infeasible)) keeps the triangle at ~6.86+6.05 scale. Data fixes positions, not the unknown-tail S-fluctuation. The wave remains valuable for the k_L-type census (now DONE via the window RS - only 9 Z-evals needed, minutes, not 100 days) and A0_data extension; it is NOT a gate route.
audit.route5_spacingCancellation: CLOSED (structural, new): a bound on the S-diff SUM over unknown zeros from the R-vM spacing law ALONE = sup over all phase sequences with the certified spacings = sum of |terms| (no cancellation guaranteed) = the count*|kernel| wall of route3 (10^12x). Cancellation requires PHASE information = the zero positions (data, route4-infeasible at 16t) or a structural phase constraint (pair correlation) = the mechanism itself.

census_datum.statement: the frontier two-unit window (tPT2-1, tPT2+1] contains EXACTLY 8 on-line zeros, computed in-house at tPT2 = 3000175332800 by Riemann-Siegel Z(t) (N = sqrt(t/2pi) = 691008 terms, 80-bit longdouble; day080). Roots at t + {-0.88769531, -0.57128906, -0.46777344, -0.31542969, -0.06933594, +0.28613281, +0.43457031, +0.70410156} (5 in (t-1, t], 3 in (t, t+1]).
census_datum.verification: 3-way: (a) mpmath dps-50 Z at every root: |Z| ~ 1e-3..4e-2 (on the zeros); |Z(tPT2)| = 2.572018 (t away from all 8); (b) R-vM main-term two-unit prediction 2*ln(t/2pi)/(2pi) = 8.5599 vs measured 8 (within +/-1); (c) the longdouble theta-part of the unit S-difference = +4.27996532 matches day078 dmain(tPT2) = 4.279965 to 7 digits (the engine is validated against the 0276 record). The in-repo data stops at gData = 3.0001e10; these 8 ordinates (to 1e-6) are NEW data, provenance: day080 (this commit).
census_datum.relation_to_gate: the 0275 certified window bound (<= 22 zeros) counts ALL zeros (including possible off-line FACE zeros); the 8 measured are on-line BULK (Re = 1/2, the day074 on-line-ness regime). The gate (0276) targets the FACE part: the window is certified window-free of FACE zeros iff the face-zero S-diff stays <= cGate over the sup - the 8 on-line zeros are available data for any mechanism, and their S-contribution to fluc is the known-side S-stream territory (not the gate leg). Certified window upper 22, measured on-line 8 -> face-part upper 14 (22 - 8, the on-line part subtracts from the total bound); the gate still must exclude the face part.
census_datum.S_datum: the smooth theta-part of S(t+1)-S(t) at tPT2 = (1/2pi)ln(t/2pi) = 4.27996532 (known exactly); the pointwise S-oscillation net residual ~ 1e-3 (within the longdouble +-7e-4 theta/float noise, consistent with the 3 window zeros' (2/pi)-jumps netting near zero). The measured POINT passes the gate pointwise (1e-3 << 2.5821); the gate is a SUP-level input over the piece (published 12.9117) - the sup REMAINS the input (honest: the point datum is encouraging but not a gate close).

content.conclusion: every non-mechanism route to the gate is now audited and closed with a number. The 0276 gate (per-piece S-diff <= 2.5821/2.5805/2.5809/2.5847, uniform in t >= tPT2) is the exact remaining input of the face, and ONLY a mechanism can deliver it: 0278 = the mechanism unit (research), named candidates: (1) a face-localized pair-correlation estimate for the unknown zeros' S-phases at unit scale (the Conrey-Ghosh-type machinery at h = 1 vs h ~ 1/ln t - the unit scale is the new territory); (2) an S-method with the face kernel (the 0274 g2-cut kernel as the S-test function - the S-method gives S-bounds with the kernel shape; face localization is the novelty); (3) a hybrid: the known-side S-stream (9.07e9 known zeros) as a probe/correlator for the unknown tail phases (the data-side of pair correlation). All three are genuinely new mathematics (no published result delivers 2.58 at unit scale). If 0278 fails, the 0275/0276/0277 ceiling is the final structural verdict of the route (b) program and the record stands: face OPEN, window bounded (<= 22, 8 on-line measured), no RH claim.

The pointwise S-diff ~1e-3 passing the gate pointwise does NOT close the gate (the gate is a sup-level, all-t, mechanism input).
